title: fix(llm-analytics): capture Anthropic and OpenAI cache token usage

files.patch:
@@ -0,0 +1,5 @@
+---
+hex/posthog: patch
+---
+
+LLM analytics events captured by the Req integration now include `$ai_cache_read_input_tokens` and `$ai_cache_creation_input_tokens` for Anthropic and OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions and Responses APIs (along with `$ai_cache_reporting_exclusive: false` for inclusive OpenAI-shaped responses, when input tokens include the cache tokens), so cached input tokens are priced correctly.

@@ -364,6 +384,40 @@ defmodule PostHog.Integrations.LLMAnalytics.Req do
 
   defp response_properties(_), do: %{}
 
+  # OpenAI-style usage counts cached tokens inside the input total. Flag it as
+  # non-exclusive so the backend does not infer Anthropic-style exclusive
+  # reporting from a claude model name served through OpenAI-compatible APIs.
+  defp put_openai_cache(properties, details) when is_map(details) do
+    properties
+    |> put_cache_read(details["cached_tokens"])
+    |> put_cache_creation(details["cache_write_tokens"])
+    |> then(fn props ->
+      cache_total =
+        Map.get(props, :"$ai_cache_read_input_tokens", 0) +
+          Map.get(props, :"$ai_cache_creation_input_tokens", 0)
+
+      # Only flag inclusive reporting when input tokens can actually contain
+      # the cache tokens; otherwise let the backend infer exclusivity.
+      input_tokens = Map.get(props, :"$ai_input_tokens")
+
+      if cache_total > 0 and is_integer(input_tokens) and input_tokens >= cache_total,
+        do: Map.put(props, :"$ai_cache_reporting_exclusive", false),
+        else: props
+    end)
+  end
+
+  defp put_openai_cache(properties, _), do: properties
+
+  defp put_cache_read(properties, tokens) when is_integer(tokens) and tokens > 0,
+    do: Map.put(properties, :"$ai_cache_read_input_tokens", tokens)
+
+  defp put_cache_read(properties, _), do: properties
+
+  defp put_cache_creation(properties, tokens) when is_integer(tokens) and tokens > 0,
+    do: Map.put(properties, :"$ai_cache_creation_input_tokens", tokens)
+
+  defp put_cache_creation(properties, _), do: properties
+
   defp gemini_url_context?(candidates) when is_list(candidates) do
     Enum.any?(candidates, &(is_map(&1) and is_map(Map.get(&1, "urlContextMetadata"))))
   end

@@ -1091,4 +1091,298 @@ defmodule PostHog.Integrations.LLMAnalytics.ReqTest do
              }
            ] = all_captured(@supervisor_name)
   end
+
+  describe "cache token usage" do
+    test "captures Anthropic cache read and creation tokens", %{req: req} do
+      Req.Test.expect(@mock_module, fn conn ->
+        Req.Test.json(conn, %{
+          "content" => [%{"text" => "hi", "type" => "text"}],
+          "model" => "claude-haiku-4-5-20251001",
+          "usage" => %{
+            "cache_creation_input_tokens" => 30,
+            "cache_read_input_tokens" => 40,
+            "input_tokens" => 5,
+            "output_tokens" => 7
+          }
+        })
+      end)
+
+      Req.post!(req, url: "https://api.anthropic.com/v1/messages", json: %{messages: []})
+
+      assert [%{properties: properties}] = all_captured(@supervisor_name)
+      assert properties[:"$ai_input_tokens"] == 5
+      assert properties[:"$ai_cache_read_input_tokens"] == 40
+      assert properties[:"$ai_cache_creation_input_tokens"] == 30
+      refute Map.has_key?(properties, :"$ai_cache_reporting_exclusive")
+    end
+
+    test "omits cache properties when Anthropic reports zero", %{req: req} do
+      Req.Test.expect(@mock_module, fn conn ->
+        Req.Test.json(conn, %{
+          "content" => [],
+          "model" => "claude-haiku-4-5-20251001",
+          "usage" => %{
+            "cache_creation_input_tokens" => 0,
+            "cache_read_input_tokens" => 0,
+            "input_tokens" => 5,
+            "output_tokens" => 7
+          }
+        })
+      end)
+
+      Req.post!(req, url: "https://api.anthropic.com/v1/messages", json: %{messages: []})
+
+      assert [%{properties: properties}] = all_captured(@supervisor_name)
+      refute Map.has_key?(properties, :"$ai_cache_read_input_tokens")
+      refute Map.has_key?(properties, :"$ai_cache_creation_input_tokens")
+    end
+
+    test "captures OpenAI Chat Completions cached tokens", %{req: req} do
+      Req.Test.expect(@mock_module, fn conn ->
+        Req.Test.json(conn, %{
+          "choices" => [],
+          "model" => "gpt-5-mini",
+          "usage" => %{
+            "completion_tokens" => 9,
+            "prompt_tokens" => 100,
+            "prompt_tokens_details" => %{"cached_tokens" => 64}
+          }
+        })
+      end)
+
+      Req.post!(req, url: "https://api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions", json: %{messages: []})
+
+      assert [%{properties: properties}] = all_captured(@supervisor_name)
+      assert properties[:"$ai_input_tokens"] == 100
+      assert properties[:"$ai_cache_read_input_tokens"] == 64
+      assert properties[:"$ai_cache_reporting_exclusive"] == false
+    end
+
+    test "flags non-exclusive reporting for claude models via OpenAI-compatible chat", %{req: req} do
+      Req.Test.expect(@mock_module, fn conn ->
+        Req.Test.json(conn, %{
+          "choices" => [],
+          "model" => "anthropic/claude-sonnet-4",
+          "usage" => %{
+            "completion_tokens" => 9,
+            "prompt_tokens" => 100,
+            "prompt_tokens_details" => %{"cached_tokens" => 64, "cache_write_tokens" => 10}
+          }
+        })
+      end)
+
+      Req.post!(req, url: "https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/chat/completions", json: %{messages: []})
+
+      assert [%{properties: properties}] = all_captured(@supervisor_name)
+      assert properties[:"$ai_input_tokens"] == 100
+      assert properties[:"$ai_cache_read_input_tokens"] == 64
+      assert properties[:"$ai_cache_creation_input_tokens"] == 10
+      assert properties[:"$ai_cache_reporting_exclusive"] == false
+    end
+
+    test "captures OpenAI Responses cached tokens", %{req: req} do
+      Req.Test.expect(@mock_module, fn conn ->
+        Req.Test.json(conn, %{
+          "model" => "gpt-5-mini",
+          "output" => [],
+          "tools" => [],
+          "temperature" => 1.0,
+          "usage" => %{
+            "input_tokens" => 100,
+            "input_tokens_details" => %{"cached_tokens" => 64},
+            "output_tokens" => 9
+          }
+        })
+      end)
+
+      Req.post!(req, url: "https://api.openai.com/v1/responses", json: %{input: "hi"})
+
+      assert [%{properties: properties}] = all_captured(@supervisor_name)
+      assert properties[:"$ai_cache_read_input_tokens"] == 64
+      assert properties[:"$ai_cache_reporting_exclusive"] == false
+    end
+
+    for cached <- [0, nil] do
+      test "omits cache properties for OpenAI Chat Completions with cached_tokens #{inspect(cached)}",
+           %{req: req} do
+        Req.Test.expect(@mock_module, fn conn ->
+          Req.Test.json(conn, %{
+            "choices" => [],
+            "model" => "gpt-5-mini",
+            "usage" => %{
+              "completion_tokens" => 9,
+              "prompt_tokens" => 100,
+              "prompt_tokens_details" => %{"cached_tokens" => unquote(cached)}
+            }
+          })
+        end)
+
+        Req.post!(req, url: "https://api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions", json: %{messages: []})
+
+        assert [%{properties: properties}] = all_captured(@supervisor_name)
+        refute Map.has_key?(properties, :"$ai_cache_read_input_tokens")
+        refute Map.has_key?(properties, :"$ai_cache_creation_input_tokens")
+        refute Map.has_key?(properties, :"$ai_cache_reporting_exclusive")
+      end
+    end
+
+    test "omits cache properties for OpenAI Responses with zero cached tokens", %{req: req} do
+      Req.Test.expect(@mock_module, fn conn ->
+        Req.Test.json(conn, %{
+          "model" => "gpt-5-mini",
+          "output" => [],
+          "tools" => [],
+          "temperature" => 1.0,
+          "usage" => %{
+            "input_tokens" => 100,
+            "input_tokens_details" => %{"cached_tokens" => 0},
+            "output_tokens" => 9
+          }
+        })
+      end)
+
+      Req.post!(req, url: "https://api.openai.com/v1/responses", json: %{input: "hi"})
+
+      assert [%{properties: properties}] = all_captured(@supervisor_name)
+      refute Map.has_key?(properties, :"$ai_cache_read_input_tokens")
+      refute Map.has_key?(properties, :"$ai_cache_creation_input_tokens")
+      refute Map.has_key?(properties, :"$ai_cache_reporting_exclusive")
+    end
+
+    for {label, details} <- [
+          {"zero cached_tokens", %{"cached_tokens" => 0, "cache_write_tokens" => 10}},
+          {"absent cached_tokens", %{"cache_write_tokens" => 10}}
+        ] do
+      test "captures write-only cache usage in Chat Completions with #{label}", %{req: req} do
+        Req.Test.expect(@mock_module, fn conn ->
+          Req.Test.json(conn, %{
+            "choices" => [],
+            "model" => "anthropic/claude-sonnet-4",
+            "usage" => %{
+              "completion_tokens" => 9,
+              "prompt_tokens" => 100,
+              "prompt_tokens_details" => unquote(Macro.escape(details))
+            }
+          })
+        end)
+
+        Req.post!(req,
+          url: "https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/chat/completions",
+          json: %{messages: []}
+        )
+
+        assert [%{properties: properties}] = all_captured(@supervisor_name)
+        refute Map.has_key?(properties, :"$ai_cache_read_input_tokens")
+        assert properties[:"$ai_cache_creation_input_tokens"] == 10
+        assert properties[:"$ai_cache_reporting_exclusive"] == false
+      end
+
+      test "captures write-only cache usage in Responses with #{label}", %{req: req} do
+        Req.Test.expect(@mock_module, fn conn ->
+          Req.Test.json(conn, %{
+            "model" => "anthropic/claude-sonnet-4",
+            "output" => [],
+            "tools" => [],
+            "temperature" => 1.0,
+            "usage" => %{
+              "input_tokens" => 100,
+              "input_tokens_details" => unquote(Macro.escape(details)),
+              "output_tokens" => 9
+            }
+          })
+        end)
+
+        Req.post!(req, url: "https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/responses", json: %{input: "hi"})
+
+        assert [%{properties: properties}] = all_captured(@supervisor_name)
+        refute Map.has_key?(properties, :"$ai_cache_read_input_tokens")
+        assert properties[:"$ai_cache_creation_input_tokens"] == 10
+        assert properties[:"$ai_cache_reporting_exclusive"] == false
+      end
+    end
+
+    test "omits $ai_cache_reporting_exclusive when cache tokens exceed input tokens", %{req: req} do
+      Req.Test.expect(@mock_module, fn conn ->
+        Req.Test.json(conn, %{
+          "choices" => [],
+          "model" => "xiaomi/mimo-v2.5",
+          "usage" => %{
+            "completion_tokens" => 9,
+            "prompt_tokens" => 149,
+            "prompt_tokens_details" => %{"cached_tokens" => 23_104}
+          }
+        })
+      end)
+
+      Req.post!(req, url: "https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/chat/completions", json: %{messages: []})
+
+      assert [%{properties: properties}] = all_captured(@supervisor_name)
+      assert properties[:"$ai_input_tokens"] == 149
+      assert properties[:"$ai_cache_read_input_tokens"] == 23_104
+      refute Map.has_key?(properties, :"$ai_cache_reporting_exclusive")
+    end
+
+    test "preserves caller-supplied $ai_cache_reporting_exclusive from span", %{req: req} do
+      Req.Test.expect(@mock_module, fn conn ->
+        Req.Test.json(conn, %{
+          "choices" => [],
+          "model" => "custom-model",
+          "usage" => %{
+            "completion_tokens" => 9,
+            "prompt_tokens" => 100,
+            "prompt_tokens_details" => %{"cached_tokens" => 64}
+          }
+        })
+      end)
+
+      LLMAnalytics.start_span(@supervisor_name, %{"$ai_cache_reporting_exclusive": true})
+      Req.post!(req, url: "https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/chat/completions", json: %{messages: []})
+
+      assert [%{properties: properties}] = all_captured(@supervisor_name)
+      assert properties[:"$ai_cache_reporting_exclusive"] == true
+    end
+
+    test "preserves caller-supplied $ai_cache_reporting_exclusive from context", %{req: req} do
+      Req.Test.expect(@mock_module, fn conn ->
+        Req.Test.json(conn, %{
+          "choices" => [],
+          "model" => "custom-model",
+          "usage" => %{
+            "completion_tokens" => 9,
+            "prompt_tokens" => 100,
+            "prompt_tokens_details" => %{"cached_tokens" => 64}
+          }
+        })
+      end)
+
+      PostHog.set_context(@supervisor_name, %{"$ai_cache_reporting_exclusive": true})
+      Req.post!(req, url: "https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/chat/completions", json: %{messages: []})
+
+      assert [%{properties: properties}] = all_captured(@supervisor_name)
+      assert properties[:"$ai_cache_reporting_exclusive"] == true
+    end
+
+    test "preserves caller-supplied string-key $ai_cache_reporting_exclusive from span", %{
+      req: req
+    } do
+      Req.Test.expect(@mock_module, fn conn ->
+        Req.Test.json(conn, %{
+          "choices" => [],
+          "model" => "custom-model",
+          "usage" => %{
+            "completion_tokens" => 9,
+            "prompt_tokens" => 100,
+            "prompt_tokens_details" => %{"cached_tokens" => 64}
+          }
+        })
+      end)
+
+      LLMAnalytics.start_span(@supervisor_name, %{"$ai_cache_reporting_exclusive" => true})
+      Req.post!(req, url: "https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/chat/completions", json: %{messages: []})
+
+      assert [%{properties: properties}] = all_captured(@supervisor_name)
+      assert properties["$ai_cache_reporting_exclusive"] == true
+      refute Map.has_key?(properties, :"$ai_cache_reporting_exclusive")
+    end
+  end
 end
